name: Media Hub (Preview)
overview: In-process media and Discord integration for Jellyfin 12.2. Requires compatible File Transformation and Plugin Pages. Preview.
description: Requires separately installed, Jellyfin 12.2-compatible File Transformation (>=2.2.1.0) and Plugin Pages (>=3.0.0.0) for automatic native Web controls and ordinary-user pages. Tested with 3.0.2.0 of both; runtime checks use API capabilities, not exact pins. Engines are not bundled or downloaded by Media Hub. Provides grouped settings, linking, scoped discovery/confirmed requests, native libraries, watchlists/Seerr reconciliation, selected music/book requests, notifications, operator messaging and optional Discord Activity. Removal requires requester ownership, current viewer consent, a full delay and approved Arr destinations; automatic removal defaults off. Optional native watch parties use Private SyncPlay 0.1.5 / API 1.1. Feature completion and remaining live-service acceptance are not certified.
